title: Random Jump Forests
abstract: arXiv:2610.32498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random jump forests are introduced as a nonparametric tool for estimating conditional cumulative transition rates and occupation probabilities in multi-state models. The main idea is that a single tree partitions the covariate space for all transitions simultaneously, using partially observed trajectories, and with Nelson--Aalen estimators at the terminal nodes. Occupation probabilities are recovered through the product integral without requiring the Markov assumption. Uniform consistency and a functional central limit theorem for the estimators of cumulative rates can be established under the assumption that the covariate vector takes finitely many values, and under suitable splitting conditions. In particular, pointwise confidence intervals and simultaneous bands are available in the Markov case. translated_abstract: 本文引入随机跳跃森林，作为一种非参数工具，用于估计多状态模型中的条件累积转移率和占据概率。其主要思想是：利用部分观测到的轨迹，让单棵树同时为所有转移划分协变量空间，并在终端节点处使用Nelson-Aalen估计量。占据概率通过乘积积分恢复，而无需马尔可夫假设。在协变量向量取有限多个值的假设以及适当的分裂条件下，可以建立累积率估计量的一致性和泛函中心极限定理。特别地，在马尔可夫情形下可以给出逐点置信区间和同时置信带。模拟研究表明，该方法的预测精度接近于正确设定的基准模型，而当基准模型被……时则有显著改进。
tldr: 本文提出随机跳跃森林这一非参数方法，利用单棵树同时划分协变量空间并在节点处结合Nelson-Aalen估计，无需马尔可夫假设即可估计多状态模型中的条件累积转移率与占据概率，并建立了一致性和泛函中心极限定理等理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces random jump forests, a nonparametric method that uses a single tree to partition the covariate space for all transitions with Nelson–Aalen estimators at terminal nodes, enabling estimation of conditional cumulative transition rates and occupation probabilities in multi-state models without the Markov assumption, supported by uniform consistency and a functional central limit theorem.
